questions.def: Use 'was' to report past actions/statements in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ going to the party.

questions.def: Use 'had bought' for past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: She told me she ___ a new car.

questions.def: Use past perfect 'had eaten' to report a completed past action.
questions.question: She said she ___ all the cake.

questions.def: Use 'were' for plural subjects in past simple reported speech.
questions.question: They said they ___ tired yesterday.

questions.def: Use 'if' for yes/no questions in reported speech.
questions.question: He asked me ___ I liked pizza.

questions.def: Use 'had gone' for past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: He told me he ___ to the store.

questions.def: 'Will' changes to 'would' in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ be late.

questions.def: Use 'had lived' to reflect past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: They told us they ___ here for years.

questions.def: Use 'had made' for past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ dinner.

questions.def: 'Is going to' changes to 'was going to' in reported speech.
questions.question: He told me he ___ to call me later.

questions.def: Use 'what' to report 'what' questions.
questions.question: She asked me ___ time it was.

questions.def: Use 'had lived' for past perfect in reported speech.

questions.def: 'Is' changes to 'was' in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ happy to see me.

questions.def: Use 'whether' for yes/no questions in reported speech.
questions.question: He asked me ___ I had finished my work.

questions.def: Use 'had worked' for past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: He told me he ___ there for 5 years.

questions.def: 'Are' changes to 'were' in reported speech.
questions.question: They said they ___ coming to the party.

questions.def: Use 'what' to report 'what' questions.

questions.def: Use 'had seen' for past perfect in reported speech.

questions.def: 'Will' changes to 'would' in reported speech.

questions.def: Use 'what' to report 'what' questions.

questions.def: Use 'had bought' for past perfect in reported speech.

questions.def: 'Is' changes to 'was' in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ tired.

questions.def: Use 'if' for yes/no questions in reported speech.

questions.def: In reported speech, 'will' changes to 'would' for future actions.
questions.question: She said she ___ me the book tomorrow.

questions.def: 'Will' changes to 'would' in reported speech, conditional sentences.
questions.question: He told me he ___ to the party if he had time.

questions.def: Reported speech changes the tense: present simple becomes past simple.
questions.question: He said he ___ it was a good idea.

questions.def: Present perfect becomes past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ already finished the project.

questions.def: Use 'if' or 'whether' to report yes/no questions.
questions.question: He asked me ___ I liked pizza.

questions.def: Past simple becomes past perfect when reporting past events.
questions.question: He told me he ___ to the store yesterday.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous becomes past perfect continuous.
questions.question: They said they ___ been working all day.
